new.name: Base
new.source:
type Base = Base {
  table: Table,
  by_id: Map(Int, (Int, List(Json))),
  by_seq: Map(Int, List(Json)),
  used: Map(Int, Unit),
  next_seq: Int
}

new.name: Db
new.source: type Db = Db { tables: List(Base), views: Map(String, View), revision: Int }

new.name: apply_batch
new.source:
fn apply_batch(db : Db, changes : List(Json)) : Db =
  var tables := db.tables
  var deltas := map(\(_) -> map_empty, db.tables)
  for ch in sof(changes) do
    let op = text(getfield(ch, "op"))
    let ti = find_base(tables, text(getfield(ch, "table")))
    var b : Base := at(tables, ti)
    let id = integer(getfield(ch, "id"))
    var ev := at(deltas, ti)
    if op == "delete" then
      match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
        Some((seq, old)) =>
          tables := list_set(
              tables,
              ti,
              Base { ..b, by_id = map_delete(id, b.by_id), by_seq = map_delete(seq, b.by_seq) },
            )
          ev := ev_remove(ev, seq, old)
        None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    else
      let row = validate_row(b.table, getfield(ch, "row"))
      if op == "insert" then
        demand(not(map_member(id, b.used)), "ROW_ID_USED")
        let seq = b.next_seq
        tables := list_set(
            tables,
            ti,
            Base {
              ..b,
              by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id),
              by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq),
              used = map_insert(id, (), b.used),
              next_seq = seq + 1
            },
          )
        ev := ev_add(ev, seq, row)
      else
        match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
          Some((seq, old)) =>
            tables := list_set(
                tables,
                ti,
                Base { ..b, by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id), by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq) },
              )
            ev := ev_add(ev_remove(ev, seq, old), seq, row)
          None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    deltas := list_set(deltas, ti, ev)
  var views := db.views
  for nv in sof(map_to_list(db.views)) do
    let (name, view) = nv
    var v : View := view
    for i in srange(0, length(v.sources)) do
      let (rem, add) = ev_lists(at(deltas, at(v.sources, i)))
      if length(rem) > 0 || length(add) > 0 then
        v := apply_source(v, i, rem, add)
    views := map_insert(name, v, views)
  Db { tables = tables, views = views, revision = db.revision + 1 }

fn db_of(database : List(Table)) : Db =
  Db { tables = map(base_of, database), views = map_empty, revision = 0 }

new.name: run_commands
new.source:
fn run_commands(db0 : Db, commands : List(Json)) : List(Json) =
  var db := db0
  var replies := []
  for c in sof(commands) do
    let current = db
    let (reply, next) =
      handle run_command(current, c) with
        never reject(code) => (error_reply(code), current)
        return r => r
    db := next
    replies := append(replies, [reply])
  replies

new.name: base_of
new.source:
fn base_of(t : Table) : Base =
  var by_id := map_empty
  var by_seq := map_empty
  var used := map_empty
  var n := 0
  for row in sof(t.rows) do
    n += 1
    by_id := map_insert(n, (n, row), by_id)
    by_seq := map_insert(n, row, by_seq)
    used := map_insert(n, (), used)
  Base {
    table = Table { ..t, rows = [] },
    by_id = by_id,
    by_seq = by_seq,
    used = used,
    next_seq = n + 1
  }

    _ => false

fn table_name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(\(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)), range(0, byte_len(s)))

new.name: validate_change
new.source:
fn validate_change(ch : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(ch)
  if op == "insert" || op == "update" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id", "row"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(ch, "row") of
      JArr(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "delete" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  else
    bad()
  demand(table_name_ok(str_field(ch, "table")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  match getfield(ch, "id") of
    JInt(n) => demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    _ => bad()

new.name: validate_command
new.source:
fn validate_command(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(c)
  if op == "create" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view", "sql", "optimize"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = str_field(c, "sql")
    match getfield(c, "optimize") of
      JBool(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "read" || op == "drop" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  elif op == "apply" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "changes"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(c, "changes") of
      JArr(cs) =>
        demand(length(cs) >= 1 && length(cs) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
        for ch in sof(cs) do
          validate_change(ch)
      _ => bad()
  else
    bad()

  scans: List(Scan),

  aggs: List(Expr),

new.name: create_view
new.source:
fn create_view(plan : Plan, sources : List(Int), loads : List(List((Int, Row)))) : View =
  let q = plan.query
  var offset := 0
  var scans := []
  var stages := []
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let width = length(at(plan.tables, i).columns)
    let base = offset
    scans := append(scans, [Scan { offset = base, width = width, filters = map(\(p) -> rebase(p, base), at(plan.filters, i)) }])
    if i > 0 then
      let on = at(q.joins, i - 1)
      let (lk, rk) = equi_keys(on, i, base)
      stages := append(
          stages,
          [Stage {
            on = on,
            outer = at(q.outer, i - 1),
            lkeys = lk,
            rkeys = rk,
            rwidth = width,
            lindex = map_empty,
            rindex = map_empty,
            rrows = map_empty,
            matched = map_empty
          }],
        )
    offset += width
  var aggs := []
  var sels := []
  for s in sof(q.select) do
    let (e, acc) = collect_aggs(fst(s), aggs)
    aggs := acc
    sels := append(sels, [e])
  let (hav, all_aggs) = collect_aggs(q.having, aggs)
  var v := View {
    plan = plan,
    sources = sources,
    scans = scans,
    stages = stages,
    grouped = length(q.groups) > 0,
    aggs = all_aggs,
    select_t = sels,
    having_t = hav,
    groups = map_empty,
    distinct = map_empty,
    result = map_empty
  }
  for i in sof(reverse(range(0, length(loads)))) do
    v := apply_source(v, i, [], at(loads, i))
  -- A global aggregate emits its single row even over empty input.
  downstream(v, empty_delta())

fn ev_add(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  key : k,
  row : Row
) : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))) given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(key, acc) of
    Some((old, _)) => map_insert(key, (old, Some(row)), acc)
    None => map_insert(key, (None, Some(row)), acc)

new.name: ev_lists
new.ty: forall a b. (Map(b, (Option(List(Json.Json)), Option(List(Json.Json))), a)) -> (List((b, List(Json.Json))), List((b, List(Json.Json))))
new.source:
fn ev_lists(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row)))
) : (List((k, Row)), List((k, Row))) =
  var rem := []
  var add := []
  for kv in sof(map_to_list(acc)) do
    let (k, (old, new)) = kv
    match old of
      Some(r) => rem := Cons((k, r), rem)
      None => ()
    match new of
      Some(r) => add := Cons((k, r), add)
      None => ()
  (reverse(rem), reverse(add))

fn ev_remove(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  key : k,
  row : Row
) : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))) given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(key, acc) of
    Some((old, Some(_))) => map_insert(key, (old, None), acc)
    Some(_) => acc
    None => map_insert(key, (Some(row), None), acc)

new.name: pos_cmp
new.source:
fn pos_cmp(a : List(Int), b : List(Int)) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (Nil, Nil) => 0
    (Nil, _) => -1
    (_, Nil) => 1
    (Cons(x, xs), Cons(y, ys)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        pos_cmp(xs, ys)

new.name: view_rows
new.source:
fn view_rows(v : View) : List(Row) =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let rows =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      map_first_values(v.result, q.offset + q.limit)
    else
      map_values(v.result)
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, rows)
  if q.limit >= 0 then
    take(q.limit, skipped)
  else
    skipped

fn agg_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var gs := v.groups
  var touched := map_empty
  if not(v.grouped) then
    touched := map_insert("[]", (), touched)
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    match map_lookup(key, gs) of
      Some(g) => gs := map_insert(key, group_remove(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    gs := map_insert(key, group_add(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    if v.grouped && map_size(g.rows) == 0 then
      gs := map_delete(key, gs)
      ev := retract(ev, g.emitted)
    else
      let new = group_output(v, g)
      if not(same_output(g.emitted, new)) then
        ev := emit(retract(ev, g.emitted), new)
        gs := map_insert(key, GroupState { ..g, emitted = new }, gs)
      elif not(map_member(key, gs)) then
        gs := map_insert(key, g, gs)
  (View { ..v, groups = gs }, delta_of(ev))

new.name: agg_empty

new.name: agg_remove
new.ty: forall a. (Views@AggState, Json.Json, Model.Expr, Map(Views.Pos, List(Json.Json), a)) -> Views@AggState
new.source:
fn agg_remove(a : AggState, v : Json, arg : Expr, rows : Map(Pos, Row)) : AggState =
  if is_null(v) then
    a
  elif a.n == 1 then
    agg_empty()
  else
    AggState {
      n = a.n - 1,
      total = a.total - integer(v),
      lo = if compare_value(v, a.lo) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, true) else a.lo,
      hi = if compare_value(v, a.hi) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, false) else a.hi
    }

new.name: agg_value
new.source:
fn agg_value(e : Expr, a : AggState, count : Int) : Json =
  if e.op == "COUNT" then
    JInt(if length(e.args) == 0 then count else a.n)
  elif a.n == 0 then
    JNull
  elif e.op == "SUM" then
    JInt(a.total)
  elif e.op == "MIN" then
    a.lo
  else
    a.hi

new.name: distinct_apply
new.source:
fn distinct_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var es := v.distinct
  var touched := map_empty
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) => es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_delete(p, e.members) }, es)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    let e =
      match map_lookup(key, es) of
        Some(e0) => e0
        None => Entry { row = row, members = map_empty, emitted = None }
    es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_insert(p, (), e.members) }, es)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) =>
        let new =
          match map_min(e.members) of
            Some((p, _)) => Some(p)
            None => None
        if new /= e.emitted then
          match e.emitted of
            Some(p) => ev := drop_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
          match new of
            Some(p) => ev := put_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
        if map_size(e.members) == 0 then
          es := map_delete(key, es)
        else
          es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, emitted = new }, es)
      None => ()
  (View { ..v, distinct = es }, delta_of(ev))

new.name: downstream
new.source:
fn downstream(v : View, d : Delta) : View =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let d1 = where_delta(q.predicate, d)
  let (v2, d2) =
    if v.plan.aggregate then
      agg_apply(v, d1)
    else
      (v, project_delta(v.select_t, d1))
  let (v3, d3) =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_apply(v2, d2)
    else
      (v2, d2)
  result_apply(v3, d3)

fn first_go(m : Map(k, v), n : Int, acc : List(v)) : (List(v), Int) =
  if n <= 0 then
    (acc, 0)
  else
    match m of
      Tip => (acc, n)
      Bin(_, _, x, l, r) =>
        let (acc1, n1) = first_go(l, n, acc)
        if n1 <= 0 then

        else
          first_go(r, n1 - 1, Cons(x, acc1))

new.name: join_left
new.source:
fn join_left(st : Stage, d : Delta) : (Stage, Delta) =
  var s := st
  var ev := map_empty
  for lr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (lp, lrow) = lr
    let ms = matched_of(s, lp)
    if map_size(ms) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      for seq in sof(map_keys(ms)) do
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), append(lrow, row_at(s.rrows, seq)))
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_delete(lp, s.matched) }
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) => s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_remove(s.lindex, k, lp) }
      None => ()
  for la in sof(d.added) do
    let (lp, lrow) = la
    var found := map_empty
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) =>
        s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_add(s.lindex, k, lp, lrow) }
        for sr in sof(map_to_list(bucket_map(s.rindex, k))) do
          let (seq, rrow) = sr
          let full = append(lrow, rrow)
          if truth(evaluate(s.on, full, [])) then
            found := map_insert(seq, (), found)
            ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), full)
      None => ()
    if map_size(found) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_insert(lp, found, s.matched) }
  (s, delta_of(ev))

fn recompute(arg : Expr, rows : Map(Pos, Row), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  var best := JNull
  for r in sof(map_values(rows)) do
    let v = evaluate(arg, r, [])
    if not(is_null(v)) then
      if is_null(best) || (compare_value(v, best) < 0) == minimum then
        best := v
  best

new.source:
fn result_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : View =
  var m := v.result
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    m := map_delete(sort_key(v.plan.order, p, row), m)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    m := map_insert(sort_key(v.plan.order, p, row), row, m)
  View { ..v, result = m }
